(I)--the lord of forest trees; acted calf for trees to milk the cow-earth; sticks of this tree to be used in ceremonies connected with the कृष्णाष्टमिव्रतम् and the digging of tanks.
2: Ib. ५६. 7; ५८. १०.
^1 M. 8. 8; १०. २८; [page२-451+ ३३]
(II)--a son of दारुक; an अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १९६.
(III)--a continent; a part of किम्पुरुष equal to Nandana; there is a प्लक्ष tree here. वा. ३३. ११; ४६. 4.
--a sacred tank in कुरुक्षेत्र where played the Apsarasas; and ऊर्वशी was found by पुरूरवस् among them. वा. ९१. ३२-3.

--twice as broad as the जम्बूद्वीप and thrice its width and in circumference; Agni, the God of fire shines there; its first ruler Idhmajihva divided it among his seven sons after whose names the countries became known; there are several rivers and (seven वा प्।) mountains; people are engaged in sun worship; surrounded by the sea of sugar-cane juice (salt ocean वा। प्।); people here live to an age of ५००० (0) years and enjoy always the felicities of the त्रेतायुग wealth, health, etc; in its midst is the प्लक्ष tree sacred to शिव.
1: भा. V. 1. ३२; २०. 1-7; Br. II. १४. ११-15; १९. 1-३१, १३८; वा. ४९. 1-२८.
Another version--one of the nine continents, मेधातिथि being the first king. Divided it among his seven sons, named as शन्तहय, शिशिर, Sukhadeya, आनन्द, शिव, क्षेमक, and Dhruva. Gomeda was one of its seven mountains. The four castes are named अर्यक, कुररा, विदिश्य and भाविन। विष्णु resides here as Soma.
2: Vi. II. 1. १२; 2. 5; 4. 2-२०.
--a sacred spot for श्राद्ध; on the सरस्वती. Br. III. १३. ६९.
